subject: Estimation method in mirt and missing data

messages.author: b207b6a270f65efc
messages.subject: Estimation method in mirt and missing data
parts:
Hi Phil

Based on my previous communication with you and 'mirt' manual the estimation method in 'mirt' is Full information maximum likelihood (FIML) with the assumption of multivariate normality for person parameters. as FIML account missing data in parameter estimation, what is your recommendation for analysis of different kind of missing mechanism by mirt?

Best

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Estimation method in mirt and missing data
parts:
What kind of missingness? MAR and MCAR are valid within mirt, but MNAR is difficult to deal with and entirely situation specific, so I can't really answer this question with any level of generality. Notions of multiple-imputation techniques come to mind, however.  

Phil
